title: 🎨 Dynamic Pixel Grid Animation – A Colorful Canvas with JavaScript & CSS! ✨
description: This animated pixel grid brings a stunning randomized color effect to the screen! 🌈✨ Using JavaScript and the HTML5 Canvas API, this project dynamically generates smooth, colorful pixel transitions that respond to window resizing.
